text: Independent re-review started; prior screen-based approvals were not sufficiently substantiated and are being withdrawn pending row-by-row review. Closer source-and-output review finds additional issues in item-asharh-6: r00002/fa is a recitation rendering but labeled instruction; its opening corresponds to r00001/ar and the remainder to r00002/ar. r00003/fa is introduction mislabeled instruction, with a cut in an ongoing list. r00004/fa is a title or title rendering, not instruction. r00005/ar part 0 is an Arabic formula moved to the fa destination. r00009-r00012 split chapter headings between the first word and ordinal; their note/instruction labels are inappropriate. r00013 continues r00012 and is labeled instruction. r00006 was already reported. Detailed per-source decisions and uncertainties are in my review file; cross-row alignment may require separate handling.
